settings.editor: Thank you for joining. Download any of the studies below. A link to this page is also on its way to your inbox, so you can come back anytime.
Where every disciple begins: who God is, and the ground we stand on.

image.alt: First page of Jesus Christ, Our Foundation

settings.editor: A one-page declaration built on 1 Corinthians 3:11. Read it each morning to rest your faith on what Christ has finished, not on anything you can produce.

image.alt: First page of The Imperative of Knowing God

settings.editor: Every life is shaped by one question: who do you believe God is? A short teaching on why knowing God determines the quality of your life.

image.alt: First page of Becoming a Man

settings.editor: Drawing on Daniel 3 and 1 Corinthians 11:1, a challenge to set aside the world's idea of manhood and become the man God planned.
Studies for believers who want to move from milk to meat.

image.alt: First page of Stages of Maturity in Christ

settings.editor: Five New Testament Greek words that trace spiritual growth, from brephos, the newborn babe, to huiothesia, the son placed with full authority.

image.alt: First page of The Parable of the Sower

settings.editor: A chart of Matthew 13 and Mark 4 that matches each soil to its enemy, what it targets, and how long the Word survives there, with Scriptures for each.

image.alt: First page of Our Inheritance from God

settings.editor: A meditation on Ephesians 1 and Romans 8: what the Father has given His children in Christ, and why no believer should leave it on the table.
Richard teaches churches, men's groups, and small groups.
